projects.name: CadQuery
projects.idea: Drive plan, elevation and isometric linework from one member geometry record; use orthographic projections for measured views and separate hidden-edge styling. Give every beam/column/rebar set a stable ID and a metadata-backed inspector so selection connects geometry, dimensions and quantity rows.
limitations: SVG projection options do not automatically create a shop-drawing dimension scheme or collision-free callouts.
A mesh/display or perspective view should not become the measurement source; retain original units and model parameters.
Generic CAD geometry and metadata do not determine rebar development, anchorage, loads, detailing-code compliance or a concrete mix.

projects.name: build123d
projects.idea: Use a coordinated member-detail sheet: 3D orientation thumbnail plus two or three orthographic views, consistent unit/precision/text/arrow styling, section/member ID, revision and scale. Place selected dimensions in ordered lanes outside the object, and classify visible/hidden/reference geometry before rendering.
limitations: This is a mechanical-part example, not building or rebar detailing.
The example's StepperMotor requires bd_warehouse and its preview uses ocp_vscode; they are not needed to adapt the visual pattern.
The default branch is dev. Dimensional intent, scale handling and annotation placement still need explicit application logic; never measure paper-scaled geometry as the true member size.
Changing a DimensionLine/ExtensionLine label_str after construction does not rebuild its geometry, per the source/docstring.

projects.name: LibreCAD
projects.idea: Create independent annotation categories—overall, member, reinforcement, reference—and a searchable visibility panel. Default to a sparse overall view; show selected-member dimensions and leaders on inspection. Keep measured values automatic, support units as formatting, and reserve consistent outside lanes so labels do not collide.
limitations: LibreCAD is primarily2D; its isometric drawing is a2D representation, not a3D reinforcement model.
The manual flags itself as work in progress for pre-release builds; pinned source confirms the cited dimension/layer implementations.
Overriding an automatic dimension with arbitrary text can detach it from measured geometry; distinguish calculated values from manual notes.
Use the drafting ideas independently; no GPL code was copied into Basanti.

projects.name: QCAD Community Edition
projects.idea: Make a persistent selected-member inspector that reports ID, type, level, true length/width/depth, reinforcement summary and associated quantity rows. On multiple selection show shared values or 'varies', never a fabricated single value. Pair this with isolate-active-layer and restore-all controls and architectural-style dimension ticks.
limitations: Do not attribute the global property/type Selection Filter widget to CE: the current matrix marks it Pro-only. The property editor's type scoping inside an existing selection is a different, narrower behavior.
Other matrix Pro-only features include total selected-entity length, SVG export, dimension styles/per-entity overrides, tolerances/GD&T and named views.
QCAD CE is2D; property editing and measurements do not validate a3D structural model. No GPL code copied.

projects.name: Maker.js
projects.idea: Keep each2D member, rebar centerline and annotation in a semantic group with a stable ID. Individual SVG entities enable precise hover/selection and filtered overlays; per-layer styles allow dimensions to remain visually distinct. Derive true centerline length and extents from the geometric model, then connect those calculations to a transparent quantity breakdown.
limitations: annotate:true prints path IDs, not engineering dimension values; explicit dimension arrows, numeric labels and layout logic are still required.
Path-only export merges entities, weakening per-member DOM inspection; Separate mode preserves identity but has fill limitations.
modelPathLength sums every path, so duplicate paths, outlines, dimensions and reference lines must be excluded before interpreting a value as bar/cut length.
Missing units default SVG output to pixels; canonical model units must be explicit. Maker.js is chiefly2D/CNC linework, not a building/rebar design engine.

review.name: Maker.js
review.verified_feature: Models/paths inherit logical layers. SVG Separate mode preserves nested model groups and individual line/circle/path elements; annotate:true adds path-ID text. Path-only mode merges geometry to one path per layer. measure.modelExtents gives the bounding rectangle; modelPathLength sums all path lengths.

idea: Use a focused dimension preset by default, with optional axis/projected dimensions in the selected member panel.
Connect selection, isolate, reset, property inspection and the quantities table through one canonical member ID instead of separate renderer-only selections.
Store primary member dimensions in model units and format only at the display boundary; let the user inspect selected-member inputs before applying quantity calculations.
limitations: Rendered-geometry measurement and selection are not fabrication detailing, rebar clash checking or structural design validation.

projects.name: Three.js
idea: Use explicit semantic label layers and a selected-member-only detail layer, preserving geometry visibility independently from label visibility.
Use DOM/SVG text companions for legible member metadata, keyboard-accessible selection controls and a synchronized textual inspection table.
Implement an original screen-space label layout over the existing renderer: project anchors, measure label bounds, assign outside lanes, resolve overlaps by priority and draw short elbow leaders.
limitations: The official label example does not by itself provide automatic collision resolution, geometry occlusion handling, keyboard navigation or screen-reader semantics; those are application work.
CSS2DRenderer documents a 100% browser/display zoom limitation; test the app's chosen overlay implementation with its actual zoom behavior.
Three.js is a rendering foundation and does not supply BIM semantics, quantity formulas or structural checking.
